clusters.name: audit-preflight
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure serial gate. Writes preflight.json, creates two ai-developer-toolkit worktrees at origin/main, and cuts the topic branch ralph/plugins-copilot-cross-engine-audit. Must complete before any audit story so all three audit stories read the same SHA/version snapshot and operate against the same copilotPluginListBefore baseline.

clusters.name: audit-per-plugin
clusters.executionModeRationale: Zero file overlap on the codexu side. Each story reads its own source-of-truth path: US-001 reads the audit-main-crews worktree, US-002 reads the audit-main-ralph worktree, US-003 reads the installed Copilot plugin cache. preflight.json is read-only in this phase. The Copilot plugin cache is mutated by US-003 only; US-001 and US-002 only consume preflight.json.copilotPluginInstallPath. Each story writes a distinct findings file and a distinct evidence/ subdir under the job dir. Safe to parallelize.

clusters.name: audit-aggregation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single-story cluster. Reads the three findings files plus evidence/ and produces a single audit-report.md. Sequential by definition.
